summary: A5 correction + Lockbox contamination disclosure. The aborted 2026-10-30 legacy `bench.py --fev-full` run (pre-protocol) reached full-set position 74, i.e. it computed MASE-inputs for 73 tasks completely and task 74 partially. By manifest task_id index (build_manifest enumerates the full list, so index == position - 1) that is 36 of the 42 Lockbox tasks, across 17 of 21 Lockbox families and all 5 Lockbox domains. Only 6 Lockbox tasks were never computed: task_id indices 76, 92, 93, 94, 95, 99 (families ecdc_ili, fred_md, fred_qd, gvar; domains econ, healthcare). Consequence: those 36 tasks cannot carry a confirmatory Lockbox claim under §8. The mechanical re-partition requested to restore blindness is NOT implementable under §2 and was therefore not applied: sibling quarantine may hold only Dev-family siblings and Lockbox only non-Dev families (verify_manifest asserts both, plus the ETT ban), so a contaminated Lockbox task cannot be moved into quarantine and no clean pool exists to refill the Lockbox from. Manifest and its SHA-256 are unchanged; the §8 remedy (accept 6-task Lockbox, brand the 42 as post-hoc diagnostics, or add fresh blind data outside fev-bench-100) is an owner decision and will be recorded as a separate amendment.
